policies.name: Anyone can submit a beta signup
policies.with_check: ((email ~* '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'::text) AND (length(email) <= 255) AND (os = ANY (ARRAY['iPhone'::text, 'Android'::text, '둘 다 / 잘 모르겠어요'::text])) AND ((age_range IS NULL) OR (length(age_range) <= 40)) AND (COALESCE(array_length(target_apps, 1), 0) <= 10))
